Hilton Mumbai International Airport.text:
Currently staying at the prestigious Hilton International Mumbai, room 317. This is my first visit to the city as a frequent traveler, and unfortunately, it has been so disappointing that I definitely won't be returning.

Full marks to the breakfast team—the food was excellent, and the staff there were warm, attentive, and professional. Sadly, that's where the positive experience ends.

From 9:00 a.m. onwards, there was continuous hammering noise that went on throughout the day. Due to the incessant rains, I had no choice but to remain in my room, making the experience unbearable. What was even more disappointing was that this wasn't a one-off incident—it happened for two consecutive days.

Despite repeated reminders and complaints, no one bothered to check if the issue had been resolved or even whether I was comfortable. The complete lack of follow-up and concern for a guest's experience is unacceptable, especially from a hotel that prides itself on its reputation.

I rarely take time out of a busy day to write reviews while I'm still staying at a property, but the level of service I experienced truly warrants one. I expected far better from Hilton, and this stay has been a major disappointment.

Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel & Residences.author: Guest
Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel & Residences.text:
The rooms walls and doors are not soundproof, so you can hear all the noise from the corridor and the other rooms. When you enter the room, there is no welcome fruit or even a small chocolate—those little touches that make a hotel feel like a true five-star property.

Check-in was dreadful. I arrived at 3 a.m. and was greeted by a manager whose service was more suited to a two-star hotel and who had no idea how to treat guests at a five-star property.

The pool is nice, but the first time I went there, nobody was available to provide sun loungers or towels. The rooms are spacious and the beds are comfortable, but the interiors feel somewhat dated; you can really notice the hotel’s 25 years of age.

The only truly positive aspect was breakfast, which offered good quality and a wide selection.

Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel & Residences.author: Guest
Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel & Residences.text:
An excellent experience at the Grand Hyatt Mumbai. From the moment of arrival, the attention to detail and, above all, the quality of service are evident. The staff was incredibly friendly, attentive, and professional throughout my stay.

The room was spacious, comfortable, and spotless. After a day out in Mumbai, it was a real pleasure to return to such a peaceful, well-maintained space.

Breakfast was another highlight: a wide variety of high-quality options to suit different tastes. I also really appreciated the hotel's overall atmosphere—elegant yet welcoming.

What truly made the stay special was the team's hospitality. They were always attentive and ready to help, without ever being intrusive.

An excellent combination of comfort, great dining, quality facilities, and exceptional service. Without a doubt, this is a hotel I would recommend and happily visit again.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

Grand Hyatt Mumbai Hotel & Residences.text:
Extremely Disappointing Stay – Far Below Grand Hyatt Standards

My recent stay at the Grand Hyatt did not meet expected brand standards.

The breakfast service was notably poor, with staff appearing disengaged and inattentive. Guests were not proactively assisted, and basic service such as checking on needs was lacking. A pretty lame customer experience for me.

At the front desk, I inquired about parking charges but received no clear answer. Despite follow-ups, I was not provided with the information during my stay.

Room product  felt outdated, particularly in terms of power outlets, which did not meet the needs of international travelers. Minimal customization of amenities.

Overall, the level of service and room quality fell very short compared to other premium hotels such as ITC & JW Marriott, which offers a far superior, more consistent and attentive guest experience.

I would be hesitant to recommend this property based on my experience.

Taj Lands End, Mumbai.author: Guest
Taj Lands End, Mumbai.text:
A Wonderful Stay with Exceptional Hospitality and Stunning Sea Views

We had a really pleasant and memorable stay at Taj Lands End. From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was absolutely top-notch. The staff were courteous, attentive and warm throughout the stay, which really added to the overall experience.

One of the biggest highlights of the property is undoubtedly the stunning seaside views. Watching the sea from the hotel, especially around sunset and during the daytime, is absolutely beautiful. The only small downside is that once it gets completely dark, the sea itself becomes almost invisible, so the spectacular sea view is best enjoyed before and around sunset rather than late at night.

The in-house dining options are also excellent, with a good variety of cuisines. Vista is a great option for continental cuisine, Masala Bay offers delicious Indian food, and Ming Yang is perfect if you’re looking for Asian cuisine. The Atrium Bar and Lounge on the ground floor is another highlight — it has a lively atmosphere and is a great place to relax and unwind with a drink.

There are also plenty of things to enjoy within the property, so the stay doesn’t feel limited to just the room and restaurants. We enjoyed some of the indoor and recreational activities, including the swimming pool and a cycle ride. One of the unexpectedly delightful parts was simply spending time in the gardens. Spotting the rabbits and the beautiful turkeys roaming around the property was genuinely enjoyable — the turkeys in particular are surprisingly beautiful to watch!

Overall, it was a super fun, relaxing and memorable stay. The combination of excellent hospitality, beautiful seaside surroundings, good restaurants, recreational activities and the peaceful garden makes Taj Lands End a great place for a relaxing getaway.

Would definitely consider staying here again.

ITC Maratha, a Luxury Collection Hotel,.text:
At the end of a three week Scandinavian holiday, we decided to take it easy for a couple of days in Mumbai before returning to Kolkata, our hometown.
I chose ITC Maratha for our stay, hoping to revive some wonderful memories of my earlier visits to Mumbai when I used to stay there very regularly. I was delighted to discover that while the old world charm remains intact, the service standards have gone several notches higher.
At a time when the world is rapidly moving towards self service and artificial intelligence ITC Maratha reminded us of the enduring value of the human touch and genuine warmth. From Aakash, the airport representative, to the housekeeping team of Lalita and Aryan and their seniors Tania Paul Head of Guest Relations and Roshni Sarkar Head of Housekeeping, everyone went out of their way to make us feel special. A special mention must also go to Abhay Sharma Asst Manager Housekeeping, a charming young man who was always cheerful and attentive.
Our breakfast experience was simply unparalleled. Despite a huge rush and guests waiting for tables, Hitesh and his highly energetic team managed everything with remarkable efficiency, warmth and grace. Full marks to the entire team!
Our happy hour experience at the Upper Crust lounge was very relaxing, thanks to Anant Pandey who made sure we had a quiet corner despite the it being a busy evening.
And then came the iconic Dum Pukht. Chef Qureshi a descendant of legendary Chef Imtiaz Qureshi, treated us to some truly mouth-melting creations that simply floored us. A very big shout-out to him and his team.
A heartfelt thank you to everyone at ITC Maratha who made our stay so warm, memorable and genuinely unforgettable. It was wonderful to see that the spirit of hospitality is very much alive--and thriving--here.
Thank you ITC Maratha, we will be back soon.

Taj Santacruz.text:
An Unforgettable Celebration – A Heartfelt Tribute to the Taj Family

There are moments in life that become cherished memories forever, and our celebration at Taj will undoubtedly remain one of them.

From the very first interaction until the final farewell, the entire Taj team demonstrated the true meaning of world class hospitality. Every detail was executed with flawless precision, warmth, and genuine care. What we experienced was not merely an event it was a masterpiece of hospitality that exceeded every expectation we had.

However, there is one individual who transformed an extraordinary evening into a once-in-a-lifetime experience—Chef Nitin.

When we met before the event, Chef Nitin looked at me with complete confidence and said:

“Sir, leave everything to me. From this moment, it is my party. I promise you that you and your guests will carry the memories of this celebration for a lifetime.”

These were not just comforting words they were a promise.

And what an incredible promise he fulfilled!

The culinary experience was simply beyond imagination. Every dish reflected perfection, every flavour was unforgettable, every presentation was elegant, and every bite showcased the passion and dedication of an exceptional chef. The lavish spread, impeccable quality, and extraordinary attention to detail left every single guest mesmerized.

Throughout the evening, we heard only one thing from our guests:

“This is one of the finest meals we have ever experienced.”

The compliments kept pouring in not just for the incredible variety but for the consistency, authenticity, freshness, and outstanding quality of every dish that was served.

Chef Nitin did not simply prepare food; he created emotions, conversations, smiles, and memories that will stay with us forever.

Behind this magnificent experience stood an equally dedicated team. Every member of the Taj family worked with remarkable professionalism, sincerity, and passion to ensure that every guest felt truly special. Their seamless coordination and commitment to excellence were evident in every moment of the celebration.

Luxury is not defined by beautiful décor or grand venues alone.

Luxury is delivering beyond every promise made.

That is exactly what the Taj team accomplished.

On behalf of our entire family, I extend our deepest gratitude to Chef Nitin , Chef Jomal , Chef Milind , Chef Sanchet & special thanks to Amrita Dasgupta and every member of the Taj family. Thank you for your unwavering dedication, your passion for perfection, and for giving us memories that will be treasured for a lifetime.

This was not just a successful event.

It was an experience. It was an emotion. It was the true essence of Taj hospitality.

Thank you for making our celebration more beautiful than we ever dreamed possible. We will forever remain grateful.

Sofitel Mumbai BKC.text:
My first time at a Mumbai five-star, and Sofitel BKC made it unforgettable. ✨

I came for an Amazon conference, but from the very first moment this hotel felt like an experience in itself. Right at the entrance, the Sardar ji doorman welcomed us with such warmth and politeness — that one graceful gesture set the tone for everything that followed.

**The Welcome & The People**

Step inside and you're greeted by young hotel-management graduates — professional, impeccably and beautifully dressed, every interaction polished yet genuinely warm. There's a quiet confidence to how the whole team carries itself; you feel looked after without ever feeling fussed over. This is hospitality done with real pride.

**The Service**

Fabulous — there's really no other word. The staff were supportive, prompt and polite at every single turn, always a step ahead of what you needed. And what impressed me most: the service never dipped for a moment, even up in the second-floor auditorium where the conference was held. The same attentiveness, the same grace, whether in the grand lobby or mid-session upstairs. That consistency is the true mark of a five-star.

**The Interiors**

Simply stunning. Everything is so tastefully and thoughtfully done — elegant, luxurious, with that unmistakable five-star finish in every corner. You find yourself slowing down just to take it all in. (Do check the photos and videos I've attached — they speak for themselves.)

**The Experience**

Attending the conference here was a pleasure from start to finish. Smooth, seamless, and wrapped in that lovely Sofitel graciousness throughout. For a first taste of a Mumbai five-star, it truly could not have been better.

**Final verdict**

A brilliant, lovely experience end to end — gracious people, fabulous service right up to the auditorium, gorgeous interiors, flawless hospitality. Sofitel BKC, you've set the bar high. I'll happily be back. 💛

Sofitel Mumbai BKC.author: Guest
Sofitel Mumbai BKC.text:
Our recent stay at this 5-star hotel was truly exceptional, with outstanding service and genuine hospitality from the moment we arrived until our departure.

Every aspect of our stay was handled with remarkable care—from the warm and efficient check-in to impeccable daily housekeeping, wonderful breakfasts, and the half-board dinner experience. The dinner buffet offered an impressive variety of beautifully presented dishes, with the chefs consistently delivering excellent quality and flavor.

A special thank-you goes to the entire restaurant team—hosts, servers, and chefs—for making every meal such a memorable experience. Pondicherry cafe manager Johnny who was always gracious and attentive , Dhurmil, & Tejas,  also deserve particular recognition for their warm, attentive, and personalized service. They took the time to understand our food preferences, anticipate our needs, and make us feel genuinely welcomed and valued throughout our stay. Their attention to detail truly elevated the dining experience.

We would also like to acknowledge the wonderful front desk team, especially Manasvi and Pradnya, who went above and beyond to make our stay special. We were particularly touched by the thoughtful presentation of a personalized memento by Manasvi that was tailored to something casually mentioned, by my wife, in a conversation. That small but incredibly meaningful gesture demonstrated the kind of attentiveness and personalization that distinguishes exceptional hospitality.

A heartfelt thank-you as well to Kunika, the Front Office Manager, for being so approachable and helpful throughout our stay. She took the time to answer our questions, address our requests, and efficiently facilitate a room change when we requested one. Her professionalism and willingness to assist made a real difference.

We are grateful to all the hosts, servers, chefs, housekeeping staff, and front office colleagues who contributed to such a memorable experience. It was the combination of exceptional food, attentive service, thoughtful personalization, and genuine warmth that made this stay truly deserving of its 5-star reputation.

We thoroughly enjoyed our stay and would highly recommend this property and would be be delighted to return. A sincere thank-you to the entire team for making us feel not just like guests, but truly valued and cared for.

Fairmont Mumbai.author: Guest
Fairmont Mumbai.text:
My stay at Fairmont Mumbai was truly exceptional and exceeded my expectations in every way. The hotel’s architecture is magnificent, and the breathtaking lobby creates an unforgettable first impression. The ambience throughout the property is stunning, sophisticated and welcoming.

My room was exceptionally spacious, with beautiful views and an intelligent, thoughtfully designed layout. The technology was innovative yet extremely user-friendly, from the smart curtains that opened and closed automatically to the well-integrated room controls. I especially loved the separate, generously sized closet with its cleverly designed storage, as well as the minibar beautifully incorporated into an elegant wardrobe. The rain shower was wonderful, and the luxurious hair and skincare products were another thoughtful touch.

Every staff member I encountered was courteous, friendly and genuinely hospitable. The consistently warm and attentive service made the experience feel even more special.

Breakfast was outstanding, with an enormous selection of options. Almost everything one could imagine seemed to have its own station, and the food was exceptional in both variety and quality.

The only drawback was some confusion on the surrounding roads due to the hotel’s proximity to the airport. If you miss the correct turn, you may accidentally enter the airport parking area and have to pay a fee to exit, so it is worth following the directions carefully.

Aside from that minor inconvenience, I absolutely loved my stay. The remarkable architecture, beautiful room, innovative technology, exceptional food and wonderful staff made Fairmont Mumbai my new favourite hotel. I would love to stay here again.

Fairmont Mumbai.author: Guest
Fairmont Mumbai.text:
The Great Gatsby of Mumbai

The moment you step in, you are transported straight into Gatsby's world. The grandeur, the bling, and a 30+ft entrance lobby that makes you stop and look up before you have even reached the reception desk. The owners' taste shows in every detail, and they have clearly spared no expense in building something this magnificent. It is pure theatre, and it works.

The standout for me was the longevity spa. It has machines I have not seen anywhere else in the country, and the staff are trained, professional and genuinely know what they are doing rather than working off a script. The massage therapists have magical hands. You can feel the craft within the first two minutes, in the kind of pressure and pacing that only comes from real training.

The rooms are enormous, closer to suites than standard rooms. I was fortunate to stay on Fairmont Gold, and my room looked directly out at flights taking off and landing, which I could happily watch for an hour at a time. Comfortable beds, generous proportions, and a layout that would easily suit a family.

The one real let-down was the South Indian food. I struggled to get a basic dosa done right across my entire stay, which is a strange gap in a Mumbai hotel operating at this level. When everything else is this considered, the simplest thing on the menu should not be the hardest to get right.

Verdict: A spectacular property with a spa genuinely worth travelling for.

My recent two-night stay at Fairmont Mumbai was a truly wonderful experience.

I was staying at the hotel while attending the Longevity Summit as the official Longevity Ambassador, and the hotel made the entire experience even more special. I was given a beautiful room on the 9th floor, which was incredibly spacious, with a comfortable king-size bed, a separate writing area, a lovely sofa seating area and beautiful views. The bathroom was particularly impressive, with a generous layout and a bathtub.

What stood out most for me was the hospitality. The entire team was warm, attentive and genuinely welcoming throughout my stay. From the room experience to the service, everything was seamless and very much in keeping with the standards I associate with Fairmont and Accor.

I also enjoyed breakfast at The Merchants, the hotel's all-day dining restaurant. The buffet had an excellent variety of food, with plenty of choices, and everything I tried was delicious. The service there was equally warm and attentive.

Fairmont Mumbai is also a wonderful venue for events, with impressive banquet halls and beautifully designed spaces. It worked exceptionally well as the venue for the Longevity Summit and created a lovely setting for the entire experience.

Overall, I had a fabulous stay. Beautiful spaces, wonderful food, impeccable service and, above all, genuinely warm hospitality. A memorable Fairmont experience and one I would happily recommend.

Fairmont Mumbai.author: Guest
Fairmont Mumbai.text:
### A beautiful hotel let down by a poor arrival experience

I recently stayed at Fairmont Mumbai and came away with mixed feelings. The hotel itself is impressive — beautifully designed, spacious rooms, excellent in-room facilities and outstanding housekeeping. The F&B team was also a highlight, with courteous servers and the small, personal interactions that make guests feel genuinely welcomed.

Unfortunately, the arrival experience was far below the standard expected from a luxury property.

I arrived around 11:15 pm after a long journey for a summit, with details of both travellers already provided and confirmation received. I waited 5–10 minutes for luggage assistance and then another 15 minutes while the Front Office tried to locate my reservation. Despite showing the QR code provided by the organisers, there was considerable confusion, little communication and no sense of ownership.

It eventually became clear that although the organisers had provided the guest list, the individual reservation had not been properly created in the hotel's system. Even after the second traveller's name was located, it took additional time to arrange the room. An 11:15 pm arrival eventually resulted in a room only after almost an hour.

What was particularly disappointing was the absence of basic hospitality during the wait. No water was offered. Only after around 45 minutes did the Duty Manager ask whether I would like some. For a tired guest arriving late at night, this should ideally have been an automatic courtesy.

I understand that hotels can be busy, sold out, or face booking issues. The concern is how such situations are handled. A luxury hotel should be able to manage an unexpected problem with proactive communication, empathy, ownership and service recovery.

There was also a serious concern with breakfast. I had eggs, cereals, fruits and nuts before checkout and subsequently experienced what appeared to be food poisoning. I cannot establish the cause, but some nuts tasted noticeably rancid and the cereals did not seem particularly fresh. I therefore believe the hotel's food freshness and safety controls would benefit from review.

To be fair, this is not a criticism of the entire hotel. The rooms, interiors, facilities, housekeeping and several F&B team members were excellent.

For a hotel of this stature, luxury hospitality is ultimately tested when something goes wrong. Unfortunately, the arrival experience and subsequent food-related illness significantly affected my overall impression.

I had considered Fairmont Mumbai for a future family stay, but after this experience, I would unfortunately think twice.

**Overall: an excellent property with very good rooms, housekeeping and F&B service, but a disappointing Front Office arrival and service-recovery experience, along with a concerning breakfast-related illness.**

Complaint Regarding Discriminatory Parking Practices by Security Staff (Rohit)
Dear Management,
I am writing to bring a serious issue regarding parking operations at Fairmont Mumbai to your attention.
A security guard named Rohit is selectively granting parking access based on personal tips rather than official hotel policy. He permits parking only for private vehicles belonging to local guests who give upfront tips or commissions. Conversely, he strictly denies parking to tourist and hired vehicles picking up guests arriving from outstation or international locations (such as Delhi, London, etc.).
Because tourist drivers and out-of-town guests do not pay extra tips to the parking staff, Rohit refuses them entry. This unfair, tip-driven practice creates severe inconvenience for traveling guests and negatively impacts the reputation of Fairmont Mumbai.
I request management to investigate this matter immediately and enforce fair, standardized parking rules for all visitors and vehicles.

Fairmont Mumbai.text:
Airport Convenience Meets Genuine Luxury - With One Catch

Fairmont Mumbai is a genuinely impressive property, and it shows from the location onward. It sits right at Terminal 2 of Mumbai's Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj International Airport, and the hotel itself leans into a striking 1920s Art Deco theme — grand, theatrical, and consistent throughout the public spaces. Amenities are strong: a rooftop infinity pool, a genuinely impressive wellness spa (Blu Xone, with longevity-focused treatments like cryotherapy), a solid fitness centre, and a dining line-up that punches well above typical airport-hotel standard — The Merchants food hall with its live kitchens was a highlight, alongside an elegant tea lounge and a stylish bar. The room itself was comfortable and well-appointed, with a polished, considered feel that matched the rest of the property. Service throughout was professional and well-styled — the kind of consistent polish you'd expect at this tier.

The standout, though, was the Fairmont Gold executive lounge — a true luxury experience. All-day refreshments, a strong breakfast spread, and evening canapés and cocktails, all in a private, elevated setting well removed from the general hotel buzz. Watching aircraft on the runway from the lounge over a coffee was a genuinely memorable touch. The staff running the lounge were attentive and warm throughout the stay, and made the experience feel properly premium rather than just another perk.

One honest note: the immediate surroundings looked a bit dodgy — not what you'd expect stepping out of a hotel at this level. That said, being this close to the airport is a real convenience — it lets you beat Mumbai traffic entirely and skip the usual stress of getting to or from the airport.

We booked a suite at Fairmont Mumbai expecting a comfortable and relaxing stay, but unfortunately the experience was very disappointing.

The exhaust in the master bedroom bathroom Toliter was not working. We repeatedly raised the issue, and while several staff members came to the room to ask questions and understand the complaint, nobody actually resolved it. it was a torture to stay in the room without toilet exchust fan working!

We were eventually offered another room, but that room had an unpleasant smell. We had also clearly informed the hotel about our dust mite allergy, yet the replacement room did not appear to have been properly deep cleaned.

Another major concern was the extremely slow response time. Whether it was housekeeping, food delivery, or other services, requests often took hours. What was particularly frustrating was having multiple staff members come to our room to discuss or ask questions about our complaints, while the actual problems remained unresolved. This repeatedly interrupted our vacation and caused considerable inconvenience.

Accessibility was also a concern. My mother and sister had difficulty walking, and we found the hotel did not provide sufficiently convenient wheelchair/handicap-friendly access for their needs.

Overall, the biggest disappointment was not simply that problems occurred, but that there seemed to be a lot of discussion and follow-up questions without effective ownership or timely resolution. We expected much better from Fairmont, especially after booking a suite.

An Excellent Stay at Fairmont Mumbai – Exceptional Service
We are currently staying at Fairmont Mumbai and, having already spent five nights here with another two nights still to go, I felt it was important to share our experience while we are still enjoying our stay.
For the past 15 years, we have been regular guests at the JW Marriott, staying there twice a year. We have always valued the personal service and the relationships we built with the staff over the years. However, with many of the familiar faces having moved on, we felt that the experience was no longer quite the same.
We first tried Fairmont Mumbai when it opened, and this is now our third visit. While it took us a little time to warm up to the hotel, I have to say that this visit has really changed our perception. We have been extremely pleased with the service and, in particular, with the quality and attitude of the staff. It feels as though the initial teething issues have long been overcome, and the team has developed into a very professional, attentive and genuinely caring group.
One of the things that has impressed us most this time is the personalised service. It reminded us of what we used to appreciate so much about the JW Marriott, and it is wonderful to find that same level of care here.
I would particularly like to recognise a few members of the team who have made our stay special.
At the restaurant, Ankit, the manager, deserves a special mention. I take chia seeds for medicinal purposes, and when I mentioned this, Ankit went far beyond what one would normally expect to help arrange them for me. He was extremely helpful, attentive and genuinely concerned about making sure I had what I needed. It was a small detail, but it demonstrated the kind of thoughtful service that makes a stay memorable.
I would also like to thank Kedarnath at the restaurant, who has been very helpful and attentive throughout our stay. Manali has also been absolutely lovely and has been consistently warm, helpful and attentive.
A special mention must also go to Yogesh, the pastry chef, who has been so lovely and extremely helpful. His kindness and willingness to assist have really added to our experience, and it is these personal touches that make guests feel genuinely looked after.
At the lobby and reception, Anouska has also been wonderful, and Dinesh from the Concierge team has been extremely helpful and professional.
It is often the people who make a hotel experience, and on this visit, the people at Fairmont Mumbai have genuinely impressed us. Their warmth, attentiveness and willingness to go the extra mile have made us feel very welcome.
We still have another two nights of our stay, so hopefully there is more to come, but based on our experience so far, we are very happy that we decided to give Fairmont Mumbai another try.
After many years of being loyal JW Marriott guests, I can honestly say that Fairmont Mumbai has now won us over. We are very pleased with the service and the team, and we look forward to returning and continuing to see the hotel develop.
A sincere thank you to the entire Fairmont Mumbai team for making our stay such a pleasant one.

05 August 2026 :
Dear Rajiv,
I hear a lot of apologies & regret. I am sorry too but I want to know what corrective action has been taken if any. Sorry is a just a beautiful word, how does it bring about a change I would like to know. I want to know why this happened at every step. From booking my spa appointment before even came to stay till we walked out of the property!! WHY??
Purnima Lakhiani.

01 August 2026
I visited Fairmont Spa, Sahar, Andheri, on 1 August 2026 for their Red Light Therapy treatment, which is marketed as one of their premium treatments. Unfortunately, it turned out to be one of the worst spa experiences I have ever had.
During the treatment, my face became intensely red to the point that I genuinely feared it had been burned. Instead of reassuring me or taking immediate corrective action, the staff's response was shocking. When I asked for ice to cool my face, I was told they didn't have any. It is unbelievable that a luxury hotel spa cannot provide something as basic as ice during a skin emergency.
I then requested some face cream to soothe my skin. Rather than helping, I was told, "Why don't you buy one? The spa is just nearby." Imagine suggesting that a customer with an inflamed face should go shopping instead of receiving immediate aftercare. Only after insisting was I reluctantly given some cream.
What disturbed me even more was the complete lack of concern shown by the staff. There was no apology, no attempt to assess my condition, no follow-up, and no sense of responsibility. The priority seemed to be collecting payment immediately rather than ensuring that a customer who had just walked out of a facial treatment with a bright red face was actually okay.
The treatment also ran unnecessarily late into the night, making the entire experience feel disorganized and highly unprofessional.
For a property carrying the Fairmont name, I expected trained therapists, proper protocols, and basic customer care. Instead, I experienced poor handling of what could have become a serious skin issue, dismissive service, and a complete lack of professionalism.
I would strongly advise anyone considering Red Light Therapy here to think twice. Luxury is not just about beautiful interiors—it is about competence, safety, and how you treat your guests when something goes wrong. On all three counts, this experience was deeply disappointing.

Fairmont Mumbai.author: Guest
Fairmont Mumbai.text:
I visited the hotel for a lunch with a colleague/friend. The lobby is large and impressive with the art deco - this contrasted with the strange zig zag and twisting and slopping ramp to entrance of the hotel. Weird! Like an amusement park ride.

One is wowed immediately upon entry. Oooohhh
It feels like the Great Gatsby! Opulent and lavish. But sadly filled with unrequited love, fake Americanized Indian Dream, and deep loneliness.

Anyhow... i digress. Forgive me... As I sat in the lobby waiting, a child happened to be crying in the lobby area... A perfectly normal human happening that is to be expected. But his sound reverberated through the whole lobby and it dawned upon me that the designers may have gone for show and tell, and failed to consider a desirable human experience of rest, ease, beauty and calmness that is created by good management of sound. More so when reaching the hotel from the highway seems like a feat akin to surviving a ride in an unexpected amusement park next to the airport.

We sat in the Madeline for lunch; t'was early. There was not a single other guest and the beauty and expansiveness, the design and taste, altogether hit me again with its gorgeous art deco. Yet, my eyes kept veering to this towering large elecronic screen with stunning visuals... Alll very beautifully curated, yet again - the use of AI transformed the experience into one of a niggling irritant that simply wouldn't leave me alone... Like a small stone in fancy shoes. Who cares? They hurt no matter what!

--- I ask ---
Why? Oh why? Do we do this?
Think I am far too old fashioned and sensitive, peculiar and weird, to be able to appreciate and comment in this manner. My apologies...

I will end, nevertheless, and share with you the chill left in my bones even 8 hours later. The kind that cuts, and penetrates and leaves you cold and dark, feeling alone and lonely. Thankfully, the warmth of the conversation and the tasty Indian food somewhat helped to alleviate the angst of the contrasting experiences.

Great looking hotel! But it didn't feel so great. Do something please. Let this not be the Great Gatsby! Beneath its glittering presentation of Jazz Age, it was a story built on profound loneliness, unrequited longing, and the failure of dreams.

Novotel Mumbai International Airport.author: Guest
Novotel Mumbai International Airport.text:
Stayed 5 nights at Novotel Mumbai International Airport while I was in the city to deliver a BNI training, and it turned out to be one of the easiest stays I have had in Mumbai.

The room was spacious and smelled fresh every single day. The soundproofing genuinely surprised me. There is a metro station right in front of the hotel and I did not hear a thing. Slept well all five nights, which is rare for me when I am travelling and working at the same time.

Breakfast buffet is wide and covers every cuisine. What made me happy was the South Indian counter, idly, upma and dosa done properly.

The small things are where they win: complimentary airport drop, laundry, and welcome snacks and fruits waiting in the room with a personal note that had my name printed on it. That note made my day.

The banquet hall worked well for our training. Air conditioning was comfortable and the food served through the sessions was good.

Special mention to Nandita at the front desk. Warm, quick, and genuinely helpful. Honestly the whole team was like that. Even the aroma in the lounge is something you carry with you.

Solid value for what you pay. I will be staying here again.

Shamiana, Taj The Trees – A Pleasant Dining Experience
Had a pleasant dining experience at Shamiana, Taj The Trees. The ambience is elegant, warm and inviting, making it a lovely place for a relaxed meal with family.
We tried the buffet, which had a good overall spread and was presented nicely. The food was fresh and well prepared, with a few dishes standing out for their taste and flavours. However, as a vegetarian, I felt that the vegetarian options were comparatively limited and there could have been more variety, particularly in the starters and main course. A wider vegetarian selection would make the buffet much more appealing to vegetarian diners.
The service was courteous and attentive, and the staff were warm and helpful throughout the meal. The cleanliness, presentation and overall hospitality were up to the standards expected from Taj.
Overall, Shamiana at Taj The Trees is a pleasant place for a relaxed dining experience, especially if you appreciate a beautiful ambience and good hospitality. With a little more variety in vegetarian offerings, the buffet could be even better.

Taj The Trees, Mumbai.author: Guest
Taj The Trees, Mumbai.text:
As a global traveler and frequent visitor to Mumbai, my stay at Taj The Trees in November 2025 fell significantly short of the safety and service governance expected of a 5-star luxury brand.

During my stay, a severe safety and personal security protocol failure occurred on property. Following the incident, property management engaged in a multi-month delay rather than addressing the safety breach with immediate transparency and accountability.

Eventually, the General Manager acknowledged in writing that internal guest safety protocols were breached during my stay. Due to the documented severity of these property-level protocol failures, the booking platform (Expedia) conducted an internal review and issued a full 100% refund ($2,100 CAD) for the stay.

While the physical hotel property is modern, luxury hospitality depends entirely on guest safety, dignity, and swift executive accountability. When critical safety breaches occur, regional leadership should prioritize guest protection over defensive delay. International travelers—especially those accustomed to standard luxury governance—should be aware of these operational shortcomings. For future stays in Mumbai, I will be choosing alternative 5-star properties, such as The Oberoi or St. Regis.

Sun-n-Sand Hotel.text:
Great location and food, but compromised facilities and poor maintenance
Sun-n-Sand has a lot going for it, but key issues with maintenance and guest amenities significantly held back the experience.
The direct sea location is fantastic and provides great views. The rooms were comfortable, and the breakfast spread was high quality and delicious.
Historically, the pool area was one of the absolute highlights of the property. The addition/presence of Bastian has unfortunately taken over and compromised the relaxed pool vibe, making it far less enjoyable for hotel guests looking to swim or unwind. Ongoing renovations resulted in the dormitory ceiling leaking. Ongoing maintenance is understandable, but water leakage in guest quarters due to construction is completely unacceptable.
If you are coming strictly for the beach views, dining, and comfortable room accommodations, it is a solid choice. However, if you are looking forward to enjoying the pool area or staying in the dormitory section during renovations, manage your expectations accordingly.

The food at the hotel was amazing, with a great variety and excellent taste. We also found the floor staff very courteous, attentive and helpful. Their service added to the overall pleasant experience during our stay.

Had a really good experience at Paschim, Mumbai. We ordered the Crab Masala, Prawns Thali and Mutton Biryani - everything was delicious and satisfying.

When I asked for another one, the waiter initially told us it wasn’t on the menu, but towards the end, Harsh and Siddhant went out of their way to arrange two Gulab Jamuns for us. That small gesture really made the experience special.

Harsh and Siddhant also served us really well throughout the meal - warm, attentive and genuinely hospitable.

Add to that the lovely Indian retro music playing in the background, and it made for a very enjoyable dining experience.

Great food, great service and a wonderful vibe. Definitely worth visiting!

Kohinoor Continental.author: Guest
Kohinoor Continental.text:
Our stay at Kohinoor Continental genuinely felt like a 5-star experience, especially considering the overall service and the way our luggage was handled right from check-in to the room. The check-in process was smooth and easy, and the staff made the entire arrival experience feel very comfortable and well-managed.

The room layout was excellent, the TV was quite large, and the overall ambience of the hotel was amazing. However, the TV isn’t a Smart TV, which unfortunately makes it almost useless for entertainment beyond basic channels. If you’re planning to relax with a movie or series on OTT after a long day, it definitely takes away from the experience and spoils the entertainment mood.

The food is definitely on the expensive side, but the quality is top-notch. We ordered pizza and chai one day, and the pizza was absolutely delicious—we loved it! They also served us cookies, which were really nice and a thoughtful touch.

The location is another big plus. There are plenty of restaurants nearby, and the hotel is situated on a busy, convenient street, so getting around and finding places to eat is very easy. It was also quite convenient to get to the airport from the hotel.

The only other concern I had was the Wi-Fi. I tried working using the hotel Wi-Fi, but the connection and overall performance weren’t really up to the mark.

Apart from these minor issues, it was an excellent stay with great service, amazing ambience, a convenient location, and a very smooth overall experience. Definitely felt closer to a 5-star experience than what I expected!

Kohinoor Continental.text:
**⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ An outstanding family buffet dinner at Solitaire Restaurant**

We recently enjoyed a wonderful buffet dinner at Solitaire Restaurant with our family, and it exceeded every expectation. From the moment we arrived, the staff made us feel genuinely welcome and well taken care of. They were attentive without being intrusive, quickly helping us with seating, explaining the spread, and checking in throughout the evening to ensure everything was perfect. Their warm and professional service truly elevated the whole experience.

The buffet itself was excellent—fresh, abundant, and thoughtfully arranged. There was a great variety of starters, live counters, main courses (both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options), and a tempting dessert section. Everything tasted freshly prepared, well-seasoned, and of high quality. We especially appreciated how the dishes kept coming out hot and how the counters were promptly replenished. It was easy for everyone in the family, from kids to elders, to find something they loved.

The ambiance was pleasant and comfortable, making it ideal for a relaxed family dinner. The overall value for the quality and quantity of food was outstanding. We left completely satisfied and already looking forward to our next visit.

Highly recommended for anyone looking for a delicious buffet experience with excellent service. Thank you to the entire team at Solitaire Restaurant for making our family evening so memorable!

The Mirador Hotel, Mumbai International.author: Guest
The Mirador Hotel, Mumbai International.text:
I wanted to take a moment to appreciate Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash at The Mirador Hotel, Andheri.

To be very frank, my experience at the hotel was not entirely a positive one. There was an unfortunate situation which I feel happened because of some misunderstanding and maybe some lack of clarity from both sides. I dont think it would be fair to entirely blame the hotel, and neither can I say that I was completely right. Sometimes these things just happen and situations get misunderstood.

But what really stayed with me was how everything was handled afterwards.

Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash handled the entire situation with a lot of dignity, patience and most importantly respect. At no point I felt that they were just trying to manage me or get rid of the situation. There was a genuine sense of empathy in the way they spoke and dealt with everything, and honestly that touched me.

Its very easy to write a good review when everything goes perfectly. But I think it says much more when something actually goes wrong, and you still walk away wanting to appreciate the people involved.

For me that speaks volume about these four gentlemen and also the culture of the property.

Inspite of what happened, the way they navigated the entire situation actually changed the way I felt about the experience. I walked away without any bitterness towards the hotel. Infact, I left with respect and goodwill, and I would have no hesitation coming back to The Mirador in the future.

Sometimes you may forget what exactly went wrong, but you dont forget how someone treated you when things were not going right.

Kshitij, Leonard, Jay and Ash — thank you for treating me with dignity and respect. I genuinely appreciate it and wish you guys the very best.

Exceptional Hospitality and Genuine Care at T24 Retro, Mumbai
My husband and I recently stayed at T24 Retro and our experience was truly exceptional.
From the moment we arrived, we were met with warmth, professionalism, and genuine concern. What stood out most, however, was the extraordinary empathy and personal care shown by the entire team.
My husband was unwell when we arrived, and the staff went far beyond what we could have expected to make him comfortable. The chefs took the time to understand his needs and thoughtfully prepared customized meals for him throughout our stay — breakfast, lunch, and dinner. Every small gesture made a difficult situation so much easier for us.
Special thanks to the managers, chefs, servers,  housekeeping, security and reception desk for their patience, kindness, and attentiveness. Their care felt genuinely personal and heartfelt.
If you are visiting Mumbai and looking for a hotel that combines comfort, quality, and truly heartfelt hospitality, I would wholeheartedly recommend T24 Retro.
A sincere and special thank you to the owner of this hotel, whose thoughtful leadership and personal touch were reflected in every aspect of our stay. Your kindness meant more than you know.

Ramee Techome Hotel Khar.author: Guest
Ramee Techome Hotel Khar.text:
Booked a 3-night stay at Ramee Techome in August under Anuja. The only reason this gets 1 star is the location. For the price they charge, the experience is nowhere close to what a 4-star hotel should offer.
The parking situation was honestly unbelievable. Guest cars are left outside on the streets while the hotel’s own vehicles occupy the parking. Our car was parked outside for two nights and came back completely filthy from the monsoon. After repeated requests, they finally allowed us to park inside on the third night. Apparently, paying guests come second to their own cars.
Service was painfully slow and staff seemed completely clueless. A simple request required multiple calls. We stayed on the 10th floor and had construction noise for 45–60 minutes. I made five calls asking them to stop because I had a meeting. They offered to shift us to the 7th floor, I agreed, and then… absolutely nothing. No update, no follow-up. Excellent communication or the complete lack of it.
The mattress was extremely uncomfortable and I checked out with a severe body ache. Housekeeping is available only during fixed timings, and even breakfast, despite having decent options, was let down by painfully slow service.
This hotel seems to have 4-star pricing with 1-star service. The location is good unfortunately, that’s where the positives end.
At this price, book an Airbnb in the area instead. Better value, more space and, most importantly, far less headache. And that's exactly what we did for the rest of our trip.

Zero value for money. Poor management. Poor service. Would not recommend.

I’ve been staying at Kohinoor Elite, Kurla West, Mumbai, for more than a year and a half now, and honestly, it has started feeling like my second home.

Since I frequently visit Mumbai for business meetings, having a place that feels comfortable and welcoming makes a big difference. I never really feel homesick here. The food feels just like home, the rooms are clean and comfortable, the facilities are excellent, and the staff is always courteous and helpful.

I would especially like to mention Prahalad Rawat, one of their staff members, who always manages to spot me whenever I’m there and consistently takes great care of me with his warm and excellent service. His sincerity and dedication really stand out. I genuinely see my younger brother in him.

A big thank you to the entire team for making every stay so comfortable and memorable.

Keep it up, guys! You’re doing a great job. Highly recommended!
